title: WhatsApp Marketing in Zoho Campaigns: What Changed in the Rebuild #Shorts
description:
Zoho rebuilt Zoho Campaigns (announced 29 Oct 2026): a new editor and workspace, native WhatsApp (bulk campaigns with Meta-approved templates, trigger-based messages, WhatsApp steps in workflows), MCP support so AI agents can build, schedule and analyse campaigns, and - in Zoho's internal testing - 100,000 emails sent up to 4x faster. Per zoho.com the new version is currently for new users; existing accounts stay unchanged for now. WhatsApp sending is in paid plans.

Sources (checked 20 Nov 2026):
- Zoho press release (29 Oct 2026): https://www.marketingdive.com/press-release/20261028-zoho-rebuilds-campaigns-platform-with-faster-simpler-campaign-creation-and-1/
- Zoho Campaigns WhatsApp marketing (official): https://www.zoho.com/campaigns/whatsapp-marketing.html
- Zoho Campaigns (official, availability FAQ): https://www.zoho.com/campaigns/
- Small Business Trends: https://smallbiztrends.com/zoho-rebuilds-campaigns-with-whatsapp-sms-and-ai-agents/
- Malay Mail / Media OutReach: https://www.malaymail.com/news/money/mediaoutreach/2026/11/13/zoho-rebuilds-campaigns-platform-with-simpler-email-and-sms-native-whatsapp-and-ai-agent-workflows/500803

This video uses an AI-generated presenter (based on the creator), voice and animations. Facts are from the sources above.
Not affiliated with Zoho.

lines.say: Before, Zoho Campaigns meant email and SMS. Now you can send bulk WhatsApp campaigns with message templates approved by Meta.
